steps.content: You collapse to the ground, faintly hearing the voices of your MBCC companions.

The glowing web divides the world, distorting and twisting everything within. You are the only exception, as if locked in a heavy cage. The only reality in your grasp is the strange girl in your arms.
But her body has almost disintegrated into nothing.
A white light pierces through both of you, cutting off your words. The person in your arms trembles and vanishes. You are left alone to make sense of it all.
The gaping hole in your chest quickly heals. Chaotic noise floods your mind, forcing something into you while ripping something else away, as if it's tearing you apart.
Before completely losing consciousness, you spot the popsicle on the ground.
It has melted completely, revealing a shriveled wooden stick.
On the wooden stick, a stream of light gleams. Strange characters flash before your eyes, then quickly disappear, as if they never existed.
